summary: Frontend-only comprehensive testing of the hosting panel (Nomadly/HostBay). Tested login, dashboard tabs, Domains tab features (main domain, subdomains, quick-nav, bulk import), and File Manager. Found and FIXED one bug: subdomain display names were showing doubled domain (e.g., 'api.testingbays.sbs.testingbays.sbs' instead of 'api.testingbays.sbs'). All requested features verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Subdomain display names were showing doubled domain names (e.g., 'api.testingbays.sbs.testingbays.sbs'). Root cause: code was concatenating s.domain (already full FQDN) with s.rootdomain. Fixed by using s.domain directly when available.

issues: React hydration warnings about <span> inside <tbody>/<option>/<select> - pre-existing issue, likely from a dev tool or wrapper component

critical_code_review_comments: DomainList.js has pre-existing lint issues: nested component definitions (CaptchaBadge, NSBadge, SSLBadge, NSPendingInfo) should be moved outside the parent component
Empty catch blocks at lines 71, 85, 93 should at least log errors
The subdomain display bug fix was straightforward - the backend returns s.domain as full FQDN, so no need to concatenate with rootdomain

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All features working correctly after fix

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test subdomains via bulk import: testbulk1.testingbays.sbs, testbulk2.testingbays.sbs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend panel testing complete. Login works with nbayftest/241743. All tabs accessible (Files, Domains, Email, Databases, Security, Geo Cloak, Analytics, Account). Domains tab shows main domain testingbays.sbs with Primary badge, SSL/NS status badges. Subdomains (api, blog, dev, shop, testbulk1, testbulk2) display correctly with document roots as /home/nbayftest/public_html/<name>. Quick-nav 'Open →' links work - clicking switches to Files tab and navigates to correct directory. Bulk Import feature works - tested creating testbulk1 and testbulk2 subdomains. Add Subdomain form has all required elements. File Manager shows all subdomain folders. Fixed subdomain display bug in DomainList.js line 886-893.
